title: Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK brings MCP and sub-agents to TypeScript and Python
meta_description: Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK gives developers a TypeScript and Python toolchain that wires native Model Context Protocol servers and sub-agents directly into Claude.
tldr: Anthropic introduced the Claude Agent SDK, a TypeScript and Python toolchain for building agents on Claude Sonnet and Opus. It integrates native Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and sub-agents directly, giving teams a supported path to multi-tool, multi-step agents instead of hand-rolled glue code.
body_markdown:
## What it is

Anthropic introduced the **Claude Agent SDK**, a specialized toolchain for **TypeScript and Python** designed to integrate native **Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers** and **sub-agents** directly with Claude Sonnet and Opus models. It packages the patterns teams were previously assembling by hand into a supported library.

## Why MCP and sub-agents matter

Two ideas do the heavy lifting. **MCP** is the open protocol for connecting models to tools and data sources through a consistent interface, so an agent can reach files, APIs, and services without bespoke integration for each one. **Sub-agents** let a primary agent delegate a scoped task to a specialized child agent, which keeps context focused and makes complex workflows easier to reason about. Building both into the SDK means developers get orchestration, tool wiring, and delegation as first-class features.

## Where it fits in June 2026

The SDK lands in a month defined by agents moving from demos to real execution. It also slots into a more competitive coding-agent market, with Microsoft and Google pushing their own AI coding models and OpenAI putting Codex in front of enterprises. A supported, native SDK is Anthropic's bid to be the default substrate teams build durable agents on.

## What to watch

The practical questions are how the SDK handles long-running and parallel tool calls, how sub-agent context and cost are managed at scale, and how tightly the TypeScript and Python surfaces track each other as the API evolves.

faq.question: What languages does the Claude Agent SDK support?
faq.answer: It ships for TypeScript and Python, the two most common ecosystems for building AI agents and backend services.

faq.question: What is Model Context Protocol (MCP)?
faq.answer: MCP is an open protocol for connecting models to external tools and data through a consistent interface. The SDK integrates native MCP servers so agents can use tools without custom glue for each one.

faq.question: What are sub-agents used for?
faq.answer: Sub-agents let a main agent delegate a scoped task to a specialized child agent. This keeps each agent's context focused and makes multi-step workflows easier to build and debug.
